results.title: Rival Terror Groups Devastate the Sahel - Africa Defense Forum
results.snippet: Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and the Islamic State Sahel Province (ISSP) are waging a turf war across multiple fronts in the Sahel. The rival groups operate in similar fashion to organized crime families that fight over territories and illicit trade networks, while extorting money and resources from civilians.
